# Invoice financiers

## Firmographics

Firms that buy invoices at a discount from manufacturers and distributors,
usually at ninety to ninety five percent of the face value, and collect from
the customer when the invoice falls due. Most of them are regional, and most
of them fund the purchase from a line of credit with one bank.

## Felt needs

They cannot see which of a seller's customers pay late until they have
already bought the invoices, and they learn it one missed payment at a time.
Every one of them asks for the same thing: the payment history of the
customer, before the offer is made, and not after.
